svg.title: About Me and Life Beyond Code
svg.desc: Two cards. About Me: a frontend-focused software engineer with production experience in responsive UI, JavaScript and Node.js applications and enterprise platforms. Life Beyond Code: a rotating carousel of hobbies - games, watching anime, food, cycling and chess.
svg.text: I'm a frontend-focused software engineer who
likes turning ideas into clean, responsive
interfaces. I've shipped production UI, plus
JavaScript and Node.js apps on enterprise
platforms, and I'm now growing my React,
Next.js, Redux, Tailwind and Vite skills

g.text: Unwinding with a controller in hand
and always up for one more level.
Stories and worlds to get lost in,
Always up for a good meal
a clear head after the screen time.
on the board and off it.
